description: Lane preset 'fast': disposable or rolling-release dependencies where a bad release costs a day, not data (searxng, lint and dev tooling, pre-commit hooks). Soak patch 1d / minor 1d / major 7d; patch, minor, digest and pin automerge; major is a manual merge. Releases without a timestamp (Harbor, GHCR) pass without a soak. Extend with `local>example-org/renovate:lane-fast(<file glob>)`; the argument is one matchFileNames glob, braces allowed.

packageRules.description: fast lane: label and timestamp behaviour
fast lane: patch and minor soak
fast lane: automerge everything below major
fast lane: major is a manual merge
